create_default_config: create a default configuration dict for the H1 joystick gait tracking environment
build_joystick_gait_tracking_env: build a JoystickGaitTracking environment instance with custom config overrides
run_reset_joystick_env: run the reset method on a JoystickGaitTracking environment to initialize simulation state
run_step_joystick_env: run the step method on a JoystickGaitTracking environment to advance simulation with an action
test_sample_command: test the sample_command method to generate random velocity and angular velocity commands
